question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Her mother is a wonderful host, she prepared for us a seven ________ meal all by herself.
solution:
The correct answer is: **course**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"course"** means a part of a meal served at one time. (पाठ्यक्रम)

 
 
• **Example: **The five-course meal included appetizers, soup, salad, a main course, and dessert.
 
 
 
• **"coarse" **refers to something that is rough or harsh in texture. (मोटा)
 
 
• **Example: **The coarse fabric was uncomfortable to wear.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word in the context of a meal is **'course'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **course**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Coarser **(अधिक मोटा): Comparative form of coarse, meaning rougher or harsher in texture.

 
 
• **Example:** The coarser sandpaper is used for the initial sanding process.
 
 
 
• **Coarse **(मोटा): Rough or harsh in texture.
 
 
• **Example: **The coarse wool sweater was itchy and uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Courser** (शिकारी कुत्ता): An archaic term for a swift horse or a hunting dog.
 
 
• **Example:** The courser chased the hare across the field.
